description: Check a Robinhood stock token before an agent buys, holds or accepts it: the contract Robinhood lists, or a known look-alike? Pass a ticker (NVDA) or a contract address on Robinhood Chain (4663). For a listed token: total supply, treasury balance, multiplier, ledger coverage, open integrity flags and the look-alikes pegproof knows of. For a look-alike address: which token it imitates. On-chain observations reconstructed from chain event logs, not financial advice. Costs $0.002 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Arbitrum One).

token.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a contract address (0x followed by 40 hex digits).
